pc.name: Amafu amaphoyinti
pc.privacy: Ifayela nefu akuphumi kulolu khompyutha. Ifayela lifundwa lapha, amathayela agcinwa esitoreji salesi siphequluli; akukho okulayishwayo.
pc.numbers: Konke lolu thebhu olubika kuyinombolo evela kudatha yakho, hhayi isitifiketi. Ingcweti ebhalisiwe inquma ukuthi isebenza kanjani.
pc.stopped: Kumisiwe. Ukwakha kugcina lokho okuqedile; cindezela Qhubeka ukuze uqhubeke.
pc.info.short: Ukwakha kudinga cishe {need} kodwa lo siphequluli singagcina {free}. Khulula isikhala noma usebenzise ifayela elincane.
pc.list.empty: Awakho amafu okwamanje. Vula ifayela phezulu.
pc.list.resume.hint: Khetha ifayela elifanayo futhi bese ucindezela Qhubeka.
pc.remove.title: Susa leli fu?
pc.remove.body: {name} uzosuswa esitoreji salesi siphequluli. Ifayela olivulile alithintwa.
pc.stats: Amaphoyinti adwetshiwe: {drawn} (inani eliphezulu: {budget}) · amathayela abonisiwe: {nodes}, alindile: {loading} · {mb} MB ibanjiwe
pc.clean.hint: Dweba umugqa wemingcele ohlelweni, noma kumbono we-3D ukusuka kumbono ophezulu. Ku-3D umugqa wemingcele uyehliswa uye endizeni eliyisicaba, ngakho ukhetha insika eqondile. Inani elingezansi libonakala ngaphambi kokuthi kushintsheke noma yini.
pc.clean.draw.lasso: Cindezela, hudula uzungeze amaphoyinti, bese ukhulula. Esc iyakhansela.
pc.clean.draw.box: Cindezela ekhoneni elilodwa, hudula uye ekhoneni elicaphunile, bese ukhulula. Esc iyakhansela.
pc.clean.draw.polygon: Chofoza amakhona; chofoza kabili noma Enter ukuvala. Esc iyakhansela.
pc.big.title: Lokho kungaphezu kwesigamu sefu
pc.big.body: Lokhu kushintsha amaphoyinti: {n} ({pct} % wefu). Kungahlehliswa. Uqhubeke?
pc.log.title: Okuhlelwe kuze kube manje (ifayela lona aliguqulwa ngalutho)
pc.noise.title: Thola umsindo
pc.noise.what: Imaka amaphoyinti ahlukile njengamaphoyinti aphansi (uhlobo 7) noma umsindo ophezulu (uhlobo 18). Akukho okususwayo ngaphandle uma uthikha ibhokisi. Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
pc.noise.radius.hint: Ngamayunithi efayela. Amaphoyinti abalwa njengomakhelwane ngaphakathi kwalo bude.
pc.noise.min.hint: Ohlukile: iphoyinti elinomakhelwane abambalwa kunalena luba ngumsindo.
pc.noise.k.hint: Ngezibalo: ibanga eliphakathi kwamaphoyinti angaseduze kakhulu aleli nani.
pc.noise.sd.hint: Ngezibalo: okude kunengqikithi eyengeziwe kulo inani kuba ngumsindo.
pc.noise.done: Kumakiwe amaphoyinti: {n} ({low} aphansi, {high} aphezulu). Isikhathi: {ms} ms.
pc.g.what: Ithola umhlaba ngamathayela (256 m ngamunye, anokuphindaphinda), iqhathanisa iphoyinti ngalinye nawo bese imaka umhlaba (uhlobo 2) namaphoyinti aphansi (uhlobo 7). Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
pc.g.cell.hint: Usayizi wegridi wokusesha iphoyinti eliphansi kakhulu, ngamayunithi efayela.
pc.g.tol.hint: Iphoyinti eliseduze kangaka nomhlaba otholiwe libizwa ngokuthi umhlaba.
pc.g.slope.hint: Ukuthambeka okukhulu kakhulu komhlaba okufanele umsefo ukulandele (ukuphakama ngaphezu kokuhamba).
pc.g.obj.hint: Izakhiwo ezibanzi kunalena amaseli angaphezulu zisuswa emhlabeni.
pc.g.label: Ukuhlukanisa umhlaba
pc.c.label: Izinhlobo zezitshalo nezakhiwo
pc.g.done: Umhlaba: amaphoyinti {ground}, amaphoyinti aphansi: {noise}, amathayela {tiles}, isikhathi: {ms} ms.
pc.g.seams: Imihlanganiso yamathayela {n} ayehluka ngaphezu kwesigamu sokubekezelela. Hlola kuqala ngaphambi kokwethemba umhlaba lapho.
pc.g.seams.none: Akukho mhlanganiso yamathayela ehluka ngaphezu kwesigamu sokubekezelela.
pc.c.done: Izitshalo ezincane: {low}, eziphakathi: {mid}, eziphezulu: {high}, izakhiwo: {building} (isikhathi: {ms} ms).
pc.s.what: Akha umhlaba osukhona kumaphoyinti abizwa ngokuthi umhlaba, bese uwaqhathanisa nawo. Umhlaba wengezwa ephrojekthini njengoba kwenza ukungeniswa kwe-LAS (amaphoyinti achazwa njenge-GROUND), njengesinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
pc.s.maxedge: Unxantathu omude kakhulu ngomphetho (0 = akukho umkhawulo)
pc.s.maxedge.hint: Unxantathu onomphetho omude kunalo uyasuswa, isibonelo phezu kwamanzi.
pc.s.done: Kusetshenziswe amaphoyinti omhlaba {kept} kwabo {seen}; kungezwe ephrojekthini amaphoyinti {points} nonxantathu {tris}.
pc.s.capped: Umkhawulo wamaphoyinti ufinyelelwe; amanye amaphoyinti omhlaba asusiwe.
pc.r.honest: Lezi yizinombolo zalelifu nalo mhlaba. Azisona isitifiketi sanoma yini.
pc.r.worst: Izindawo eziyishumi ezehluka kakhulu (chofoza ukuya khona)
pc.bl.title: Imigqa yokuhlukanisa
pc.bl.hint: Chofoza amaphoyinti eduze komphetho womgwaqo, emfudlaneni noma ekuphezulu kwebhange kumbono we-3D. Ukuchofoza ngakunye kuthatha iphoyinti eliseduze kakhulu elidwetshiwe.
pc.bl.saved: Umugqa wokuhlukanisa ugciniwe; Akha umhlaba olandelayo uwusebenzisa.
pc.c.none: Awakho amakhonthuwa okwamanje. Akha umhlaba kuqala.
pc.v.title: Ivolumu yesitaki
pc.v.what: Ivolumu yendawo ephezulu kwesisekelo ngaphakathi komngcele odwetshwe. Umngcele kufanele uzungeze isitaki emhlabeni.
pc.v.draw: Chofoza amakhona azungeze isitaki; chofoza kabili noma Enter ukuvala.
pc.v.leaves: Umngcele uphuma edatheni: amayunithi esikwele {area} alayo indawo futhi awabalwa.
pc.f.title: Ivolumu phakathi kwezindiza ezimbili
pc.f.what: Akha umhlaba kwefu {a} nakwelinye ifu, bese uyaqhathanisa. Ukugcwaliswa kuyapho kuphakeme ukundiza kwesibili, ukusikwa kuyapho kuphansi.
pc.f.none: Akha ifu lesibili kuqala. Liyavela ohlwini lapha.
pc.x.title: Hlinzeka ifayela le-LAS 1.4 elihlanziwe
pc.x.what: Ibhala ifu ngokuguqulwa kwakho nezinhlobo ezisetshenzisiwe njengefayela elisha le-LAS 1.4. Ifayela lokuqala aliguqulwa. Okokuphuma nge-LAZ akutholakali.
pc.sec.what: Dweba umugqa uwelule umfudlana, umphetho womgwaqo noma uthambeka: amaphoyinti angaphakathi kwesigamu sobubanzi balo adwetshwa ngokuya ngebanga nokuphakama.
pc.sec.out: Amaphoyinti {n}, umugqa ubude bawo {len}, ibanga ububanzi balo {w}, ukuphakama kusuka {z0} kuya {z1}.
pc.err.no_cloud: Leli fu alikho esitoreji salesi siphequluli.
pc.err.bad_cloud: Amafayela alelo fu awonakele noma avela kenguqulo ehlukile.
pc.err.building: Leli fu alizange liqedwe. Khetha ifayela futhi bese ucindezela Qhubeka.
pc.err.bad_source: Leli fayela alilona ifayela le-LAS noma le-LAZ okwengeziwe okungalifunda.
pc.err.too_few_points: Kunamaphoyinti omhlaba amancane kakhulu ukwakha indawo. Thola umhlaba kuqala.
pc.err.resume_mismatch: Lena ayisona ifayela elifanayo nelaqala ukwakha.
pc.err.too_many_cells: Lokho kucela amaseli amaningi kakhulu. Sebenzisa usayizi weseli omkhulu.
